title: Record geometric multiplicity 24 for eigenvalue 0 on the pinned 216-by-216 matrix
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Proof for one pinned matrix. On the integer matrix of `B = 4 A_1` in the joint `(+1,+1)` basis of dimension 216, the rational rank is 192. Eigenvalue 0 of `A_1` has geometric multiplicity 24. The same eigenvalue has algebraic multiplicity 24, because a positive diagonal makes the matrix self-adjoint and the kernel Gram form is nondegenerate, so the ascent is 1.

The rank modulo `1000003` and modulo `1000033` is 192. Each modular rank is a lower bound on the rational rank. Equality uses the explicit integer kernel of 24 vectors and a nonzero 192-by-192 minor.

No new kappa. The selected conditional kappa stays `781451/250000000`. This does not change the selected frontier.

## Task and overlap

- Task: `formal-interface-lemma`, scope changed.
- Upstream base: `17469fff78c22941280f04d39dc5a1faee09c840`.
- Package: `research/a1-joint-216-nullity`.
- Predecessor: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6964, open question 2.
- Handoff: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19144258

The catalogue card asks for a formal caller binding. PR #6964 pinned this matrix and recorded algebraic multiplicity 24, and left the rational nullity open because a modular rank is only a lower bound. GitHub pull-request search for `geometric multiplicity` returns only that merged PR. Open PR #7008 records normalizer isotypic dimensions 8, 80, and 128 and does not compute this rank. Open PR #7009 splits different sign characters. This package does not intersect the kernel with those isotypics.

## Validation

CPython 3.12, standard library only.

```sh
python3 -B -W error research/a1-joint-216-nullity/verify.py
python3 -B -O research/a1-joint-216-nullity/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/a1-joint-216-nullity --check-only
```

Marker `PASS_A1_JOINT_216_NULLITY`. Registered replay returned `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` with outcome `completed`. Evidence class: a proof for this one pinned matrix. Kernel certificate SHA256 `4eefc84f2750988bfe22056387b427fd9de1c09093c6e4be480ffe209b207714`.

Rejection controls: adding the identity stops annihilating the kernel; an off-diagonal increment breaks the scaling identity; a zeroed kernel vector loses the positive free diagonal; a repeated pivot row makes the minor determinant 0; changing the recorded factor `(24, (0, 1))` to 23 fails the comparison. A 3-by-3 fixture has rank 2 and kernel `(1, -2, 1)`.

Not run: Lean, Docker, the degree-881 replay, a selected cold replay, and a recomputation of the degree-216 characteristic polynomial.

## Credit

JoyboyBrian's handoff is discussion comment 19144258. The sign-stabilizer split supplied `g`, `t`, and dimension 216. PR #6964 pinned the basis, the matrix, and algebraic multiplicity 24. Ali Romman's PR4958 and PR4720 retain the query and the Bell action. Nick Petalas's PR5120 is the degree-410 lower bound. Krzysztof Wojt's `research/exact-one-slot-gram` is the degree-881 annihilator. The doubled representation comes from PR1719.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. The assistant derived the kernel and checked the rank. This is not an independent human or proof-kernel review. New work is Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

- Geometric multiplicity of eigenvalue 2 on this same matrix, the nullity of `M - 8 I`. The recorded algebraic multiplicity is 12. The shifted elimination was not run.
- Geometric multiplicity of eigenvalue 0 on each of the other three joint sign spaces. They share the characteristic polynomial, and their matrices are not pinned here.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The pinned matrix is sparse with entries in `-28..28`, and the kernel entries are at most 10, so one 20-bit prime reconstructs the kernel and the exact product `M v = 0` finishes the proof. A generic Hadamard elimination is unnecessary for this matrix.
